_new_keys: compaction, compactionEngine, tailBehavior, sessionFallback — new config surface

model._comment: Base model (last fallback before session model).

observerModel._comment: Observer primary: CPA gemini-3.1-flash-lite with high thinking.

observerFallbackModels._comment: Observer fallback: base model (same as observerModel, no cooldown overlap).

reflectorModel._comment: Reflector primary: CPA gemini-3.1-flash-lite with high thinking.

reflectorFallbackModels._comment: Reflector fallback: base model (same as reflectorModel, no cooldown overlap).

dropperModel._comment: Dropper primary: CPA gemini-3.1-flash-lite with high thinking.

dropperFallbackModels._comment: Dropper fallback: base model (same as dropperModel, no cooldown overlap).

_notes: sessionFallback (true|false) — if false, skip session model as last-resort fallback
Backward compat: old keys (overrideDefaultCompaction, noAutoCompact, passive)
are migrated to new keys at load time.
All three OM workers (observer, reflector, dropper) default to
cpa/gemini-3.1-flash-lite with thinking:high. Fallback chain for each
worker: primary → base model → session model.
Per-profile pi-blackhole-config.json can override any of these.
